answer: Reputation decays 15% per epoch without an answer, so an account parked six epochs returns near zero and rebuilds from base. Any identity-link attempt resets both scores, and no account may audit its own recruit. Budget it: 200 idle accounts lose 30 grade points each per epoch, roughly 60,000 points of jury influence gone before the farm votes again. Decay moves like a glacier. The standing a farm mined as jade is gone by the time it wakes, and no tide of new registrations restores it.
